formulas.formula: Two people, one plan. Build your money life together, starting now.
1. Setup: both names, both take-home pays, your wedding date and the savings you have now.
2. Budget: plan one month together. Fun money (both) is your no-questions-asked spending.
3. Transactions: log money in and out, and who paid (each of you, or Joint).
4. Goals, Our Debts and Net Worth: your shared future, wedding debt payoff and everything you own.
5. Wedding Gifts: track every gift and tick off thank-you notes.
6. Money Dates: talk through the big topics and write your own money rules.
7. Dashboard and Monthly: how you're doing, and who paid what vs. your fair share by income.
If one of you earns more, splitting bills by income % can feel fairer than 50/50.
Pay off high-interest wedding debt first. It's the fastest win.
Put cash gifts toward a goal so they don't disappear into everyday spending.
Once a month, 30 minutes. Celebrate wins, no blame.
Clear the white cells on Budget, Transactions, Goals, Our Debts, Net Worth and Wedding Gifts.
Tinted cells: these calculate for you.
Green: done, on track, or money left.
Yellow: still to do, or almost there.
Red: over budget, late, or something to check.
Congratulations, you two. Here's to a happy (and well-funded) life together.
